ruleDefinitions.name: Startup/Logon Script Added to Group Policy Object
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects the modification of Group Policy Objects (GPO) to add a startup/logon script to users or computer objects.
 Note: Unmapped fields: AttributeLDAPDisplayName, AttributeValue, ShareName, RelativeTargetName, AccessList

sequences.query: (event_id = 5136 OR event_id = 5145) AND ((((AttributeLDAPDisplayName = "gPCMachineExtensionNames" OR AttributeLDAPDisplayName = "gPCUserExtensionNames") AND AttributeValue = RGX(".*42B5FAAE\\-6536\\-11D2\\-AE5A\\-0000F87571E3.*")) AND (AttributeValue = RGX(".*40B6664F\\-4972\\-11D1\\-A7CA\\-0000F87571E3.*") OR AttributeValue = RGX(".*40B66650\\-4972\\-11D1\\-A7CA\\-0000F87571E3.*"))) OR (ShareName = RGX("\\\\SYSVOL$") AND (RelativeTargetName = RGX("\\\\scripts\\\.ini$") OR RelativeTargetName = RGX("\\\\psscripts\\\.ini$")) AND AccessList = RGX(".*\\%\\%4417.*")))
